descriptions.d19c_motion_time_to_height_80118aac: Solve for the time at which a body at height +4 with velocity +16 and acceleration +28 reaches the target height: -d/v with zero acceleration, otherwise the quadratic roots (return 0 when the discriminant is negative), storing the earlier positive root unless 'later' is set, else the later root; return 1 when the stored time is not negative, otherwise 0.
